subject: Daz's age
fact: Daz is a male Drow apostate from Menzoberranzan who studied magic and ended up in Velkynvelve's cages.
source_quote: I am a male Drow apostate from Menzoberranzan who studied magic, held private opinions that would have gotten him killed if voiced aloud, and eventually ended up in Velkynvelve's cages

subject: contract execution duration
fact: The contract to extract Daz alive and unharmed required significant gold and was routed through a house with enough reach to make it stick.
source_quote: There had been a contract. Extract Daz alive and unharmed. House T'sarran behind it. ... Somebody had spent a significant amount of gold to ensure that the elf standing to my left made it out of this cavern breathing. Somebody had wanted him badly enough to hire professional Drow mercenaries and route the contract through a house with enough reach to make it stick.

subject: ritual duration
fact: Ilvara had spent months allowing fungal growth to become something wrong.
source_quote: the fungal growth that had crept up the stone was still pulsing with Zuggtmoy's reach, slow and rhythmic like breathing, and Grygum was not the sort to leave corruption breathing. ... the fungal matter that had spent months becoming something wrong collapsed into ash

subject: chamber dimensions
fact: The fungal mass sat at the center of the chamber.
source_quote: The fungal mass sat at the center of the chamber

subject: Drow mercenaries count

source_quote: hired professional Drow mercenaries

subject: tooth value

source_quote: she'd taken my tooth. A chip broken off in the capture, displayed in her chest like a piece of evidence of what she could do

subject: document burning
fact: The documents had been partially burned, meaning someone tried and failed to destroy them.
source_quote: They'd been partially burned, which meant someone had tried to destroy them and hadn't quite managed it

subject: Dawnbringer value

subject: Vaultmaster Locking Scabbard use

subject: elapsed time
fact: The party had been traveling through the Underdark for months, though the exact duration is unknown.
source_quote: I genuinely cannot tell you how many months it had been

subject: Overbright elevation
fact: The party emerged from a tunnel into the Overbright, implying a vertical ascent from the Underdark.
source_quote: The tunnel mouth opened like a held breath finally released.

subject: party member count
fact: Eight individuals emerged from the tunnel: the narrator, Thorin, Grygum, Daz, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and two others referred to as 'the rest of our moltley crew'.
source_quote: The others emerged around me. Thorin first... Grygum next... Daz came through last... The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: Glabbagool presence
fact: Glabbagool, a gelatinous ooze, was present as a companion.
source_quote: Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward who was now a grey ooze

subject: bag of holding usage
fact: Grygum opened the bag of holding just enough for Glabbagool to peer out.
source_quote: Grygum had opened the bag of holding just enough, and Glabbagool — our companion, our gelatinous ward... had peered out.

subject: Drow cloak value
fact: Drow cloaks disintegrate in sunlight, implying their material value is tied to Underdark use.
source_quote: I knew that Drow cloaks disintegrated in the sunlight.

subject: sequence of emergence

source_quote: Thorin first... Grygum next... Daz came through last... The rest of our moltley crew followed

fact: Daz's conclusion about going to Candlekeep was reached before the group discussion began.
source_quote: the conclusion — Candlekeep... was reasonable... was already pulling it toward a conclusion before the conversation began

subject: Daz's history inquiry

source_quote: research into House T'sarran and Jimjar's disappearance and whatever the various cutouts and hired Duskryns were ultimately pointing at regarding Daz's own history

subject: Thorin's sword quest

source_quote: he had mentioned something about a specialist — the phrase *sword whisperer* had come up

subject: Grygum's research goals

source_quote: He would look up the lore of Bahamut. He would pick up pamphlets.

subject: gold value
fact: The party had more gold than they started with, though the exact amount is unspecified.
source_quote: We had more of it than we had started with — which was not saying much, given that we had started with nothing
